boardTokens.title: Job boards (Greenhouse or Lever)
boardTokens.description: Companies to read. Greenhouse: a board token (the part after boards.greenhouse.io/, for example "airbnb") or any Greenhouse job board URL. Lever: "lever:<company>" (for example "lever:zoox") or any jobs.lever.co URL; use "lever-eu:<company>" or a jobs.eu.lever.co URL for EU-hosted boards. Each board is one request.

includeContent.title: Include full job descriptions
includeContent.description: Return each job's description (HTML and plain text) with its departments and offices. Turn off for a lighter list of titles, locations and links only.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains at least one of these words (not case-sensitive). Leave empty for every job.

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose location or office contains at least one of these words, for example "Remote" or "London" (not case-sensitive). Leave empty for every location.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many jobs. Each job is charged once.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Maximum requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Polite rate limit for the job board APIs. At most 1 request per second, which is what Lever's robots.txt asks for; the Actor also honours Retry-After and backs off on errors.
